message: You know that friend who's got a smoke detector in every room and a fire extinguisher tucked in every corner? Yeah, that’s me. I thought I was a bit overboard until I accidentally burned some toast last week. Let me tell you, my smoke alarms kicked in like a well-oiled machine! It was a little chaotic, but it reminded me how important it is to be prepared. Better safe than sorry, right? What’s your favorite safety tip?
